L069.body:
图1 只作本条的画风母图：只借它的媒介与笔触（半写实数字厚涂、可辨笔触与颜料干边、面上读得出的颜料层次、天空用笔触铺而不是平滑渐变），不借它的构图、机位、题材与物件排布，本条画面一律以下文正文为准。
【画风锚点】medium is a semi-realistic digital painting: opaque impasto brush strokes and dry-brush edges build every surface, with visible brushwork and hand-mixed edges on faces, glass, stone, fabric and foliage, and the paint kept readable instead of smoothly blended; painted illustration rather than a snapshot; the Chinese sections below describe the subject, not the medium
【画面定位】云浦结算中心位于钛湖东偏北的东湖金融片区D03北端，中心(2.893,1.879)千米。
【取景指令】相机置南面小街口人行道上(3.027,1.966)千米，离地1.5米朝西偏南，32毫米。前景为斑马线与等红灯的通勤者，中景是深灰金属板低区与检修小门，远景为塔身上部与高女儿墙。连续6秒从街口向楼体推进一米半，收录工程车倒车提示与风过绿化。255°晚秋夕光从画面右前侧掠入，设备墙保留真实阴影，不添加发光标识。
【外观辨识】塔身比同区建筑矮壮，横向窗带略宽，银钛竖肋在低区转为深灰金属板。西面设备墙有整齐的检修小门与短挑檐，不做装饰覆盖。屋顶平，四周女儿墙较高，只露出排气短管。夜间外立面几乎不亮，街口一盏连续照明。
【人群与烟火气】工作日进出的人穿着统一，背着工位键盘包，楼下便利店中午卖饭团最快。开放日会有学生团体来参观展廊，讲解员压低声音以免打扰运行层。夜里值班室里灯长亮，门口停两三辆工程车，街道很静。｜画面内人物密度缺省档：前景与中景合计15—40人，主体人物组3—6人，至少一组正在做具体的事（搬、聊、等、吃）。本条人群段与锁定段的具体描写优先于该缺省档，冲突时按详档，不为凑人数增删人物。
【锁定与禁则】锁定69层276米、矮壮体量、深灰金属板裙房与高女儿墙。禁止画成大型外露冷却塔厂区或数据中心的巨型发光门厅，禁止添加地面高压塔。所有图像无水印、无凭空文字。
【全局硬设定】虚构城市钛湖城，2013年，当代现实技术；「顶级现代化」按2010年代前沿读：玻璃塔群、LED媒体立面、地下环道与综合管廊、城市轨道与枢纽换乘、光纤到楼、洁净实验室与数据中心、自助闸机、电动大巴、施工围挡与吊装作业；不得用飞行汽车、载人无人机、全息投影、机器人服务员、自动驾驶车队或赛博义体表达现代性，不是赛博朋克；城市定位：顶级现代化科技城市 × 保存完好的中国老城街巷 × 烟火气。同一画面里科技层与老城层必须有物理接触，天上现代、地上生活——高层与设备在画面上半，人流与生活痕迹在画面下半；只有玻璃幕墙或只有仿古街都算不合格；画风：半写实数字厚涂，笔触可辨、颜料层次读得出来、表面是画出来的，不是照片，也不是描边平涂的动画赛璐璐；人物保持真实比例与实际年龄特征；本地坐标：湖心(0,0)，x向东、y向北，单位千米；方位北0°顺时针；中心湖约6.4×4.2千米椭圆，四面环山；清岚河西北入湖，澜川东南外流；默认光照：晚秋，太阳方位255°、高度6°，能见度12至18千米；清晨、夜景、雨后、阴天须显式标注为变体；天际线分层：L066钛心金融主塔458米为全城第一，L007钛湖之脊368米（含针状天线）为第二；200米以上的塔楼在内湖环金融与枢纽片区成簇，逐栋参数以空间名录为准，提示词内不复数；成簇只是正典事实、不构成本条画面的授权，背景天际线只许画【取景指令】逐一点名的独立远景对象，未点名者一律不入画；本条正文里的「远景」二字常指主体自身的远处构件，不构成另画一片城市背景或超高层塔群的许可；非对称直线斜削冠与细针状天线的组合只属于L007，任何其它塔楼不得复制该冠部；L007与L066均为直线形体，不得扭转；机场只在S02山外，跑道东西向3.2千米；不得出现第二个机场；禁止：湖中高楼、海港、大型人工岛、飞行汽车、把L007的斜削冠与针状天线安到别的塔楼上；山体遮挡：外围村镇通常不能透山看到湖面或主城天际线；正文中的无水印禁则指第三方或模型生成的水印、台标、logo与签名；招牌、店招、灯箱与门牌必须存在，但字形须是不可读的模糊笔画，不得形成可拼读的汉字或拉丁词，也不得凭空造出可读标语；平台强制AIGC角标与XMP中的TC260元数据标识不属禁则，须原样保留，不得裁剪、遮盖或修补

English tail: semi-realistic digital painting, visible brushwork and hand-mixed edges, opaque impasto paint layers with dry-brush edges, painted surfaces, sky laid in with visible cloud strokes rather than a smooth blended gradient, warm late-autumn palette, illustrated cityscape rather than a snapshot, painted landmark tower true to the canon section, modern layer (curtain-wall grid, lit sky-lobby bands, rooftop telecom and HVAC plant, LED media panel on the podium) rising out of old layer (grey-tile roofs, timber eaves, stone steps and a narrow old street touching the tower base), 3:2 横幅, the sun sits inside this frame as the canon section states (15 degrees to the right of the camera axis, inside the 29 degree half-angle), low and backlit with rims lit and shadows running toward the lens, the background skyline beyond the main subject may contain only the distant objects the Chinese framing section names one by one; the word 远景 inside the Chinese sections usually points at a part of the main subject itself and never licenses a second city, so do not add a distant downtown skyline, a supertall cluster or a tower crane that the framing section does not name; background towers are composed from this canon's own geometry (straight shafts, louver bands and the flat or stepped crowns the Chinese sections name); any far tower this line does not name a crown form for stays a plain mass with a flat or stepped top and no invented crown, antenna or aperture; do not trace a real city's skyline and do not borrow a real supertall's crown, twist or aperture; L007 钛湖之脊 (368 metres) is 127 degrees to the left of this camera and outside this frame's 29 degree half-angle, so neither its silhouette nor its crown may be painted here; L066 钛心金融主塔 (458 metres) is 76 degrees to the left of this camera and outside this frame's 29 degree half-angle, so neither its silhouette nor its crown may be painted here, painted material texture, everyday people doing everyday things, street life must read as physical traces, at least three of: hanging laundry, potted plants and rooftop planting, market crates mid-unload, steam off a street food stall, lit shop lampboxes, parked bicycles and scooters, elders playing chess on backed stools, parents collecting children, construction hoarding with a tower crane, rubbish collection point and truck, a dog on a lead, puddle reflections after rain, shop signboards, banners, lampboxes and door plates must exist along the street, drawn as blurred non-readable strokes; they must not spell legible characters or Latin words and must not invent a readable slogan, not a photograph, no photorealistic pore detail, no lens grain as the look, not a 3D render, no cel outline, no flat cel fills, not a cartoon, not an idol illustration; era 2013: no flying cars, no holograms, no humanoid robots, no cyberpunk, no near-future sci-fi, no autonomous vehicle fleets, no neon-drenched street replacing street life; no recognizable real-world skyline (Lujiazui, Hong Kong, Shenzhen Bay, Manhattan, Dubai, Chicago) and no crown, twist or aperture copied from a real supertall; nothing written on the ground or pavement in any corner; no letter-shaped signature cluster, monogram or floating glyph strokes on street surfaces, kerbs or in the four corners of the frame, no third-party or model-generated watermark, logo or signature, preserve mandatory platform AIGC labels and TC260 XMP metadata unchanged, no invented landmark, everything above in the Chinese canon sections overrides this line.
